method: Code analysis + Chrome documentation + existing codebase evidence

audioContextAvailable.evidence: meetingOffscreen.ts:532 already uses 'new AudioContext()' in offscreen - proven to work in production

audioWorkletAvailable.evidence: AudioWorklet is part of AudioContext API. Since AudioContext works (proven above), AudioWorklet should work. Chrome offscreen with USER_MEDIA reason supports full Web Audio API.

addModuleUrl.constraint: addModule() requires chrome-extension:// URL. Processor file must be in dist/ as static asset (not webpack-bundled). Must be added to webpack CopyPlugin or placed in static/ directory.
addModuleUrl.buildAction: Add spikeWorkletProcessor.js to static/ directory OR add CopyPlugin pattern in webpack.common.cjs

pcmDataFlow.evidence: Standard AudioWorklet pattern: processor.process() receives Float32Array inputs, posts to main thread via this.port.postMessage()

buildNote: spikeWorkletProcessor.js must be copied to dist/ as standalone file - NOT bundled by webpack
